infobox.usage: Unlocks an office on the second floor of the financial institution on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Financial institution office key (Finance) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to an office room at the city's financial institution.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Office on the second floor of the financial institution building at Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 5x PC block
- 1x Sport bag
- Loose loot (Valuables, Provisions, Building materials, Household materials, Energy elements)
